verdict.rationale: Push approval with number matching, location context and admin-enforced MFA policies is a fair question for an authenticator app, so the axis applies. The evidence shows Google Authenticator only generates HOTP/TOTP one-time codes, with no push sign-in, number matching, location context, or admin policy enforcement. A community report notes Google routed push approvals through other apps, such as YouTube, rather than through Authenticator.

support.subject: As an IT admin, push-based sign-in includes phishing defenses — number matching, location context, and admin-enforced MFA policies
